CustomField.label: Kontakte without Austritt
CustomField.description: SCRUM-453: Count of the Contacts of this Account that are NOT marked as having left. System-maintained by ContactLeftGuardTrigger / SCRUM453ContactLeftHandler (full recompute, SCRUM-416 pattern); von Hand nicht aenderbar. 0 together with Contacts_Left_Count__c > 0 = the customer has no contact person left any more (overview AC-8).
